totalPages is computed as Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1. With user_count=50 and limit=50 it returns 2, but only one page exists. On page 1, showingLast (currentPage == totalPages) is false, so the Next button stays enabled. The `next` action then sets offset to min(0+50, 50) = 50 and calls findMembers(). That fetches an empty page, and currentPage becomes 2. The same off-by-one affects any count that divides evenly by the limit.

findMembers clamps the offset with Math.min(offset, user_count), so offset == user_count is allowed and returns zero members. The admin-group controller's totalPages is floor(user_count/limit)+1. With 50 members and limit 50, that gives 2 pages. showingLast is false on page 1, so "next" sets offset to min(0+50, 50) = 50 and loads an empty member list.
